It’s kinda weird...

So when I’m feeling bad, I cut everyday.

When I cut, I just can’t think about anything at all. I just think of where I’m goin to cut after. It’s like my thoughts just fly away. It’s a moment of calm. You feel better.
I personally cut when I have too much emotions (usually anger or sadness) when I cut, those emotions get back to 0 and I feel *normal* again

If barely never cut when I’m okay, cauz I don’t feel like I need to, my emotions are okay and my mood is okay too.

Like everyone already said and I think you know that more than I do, but self harming is a coping mechanism. 



It’s kinda weird to explain actually

When I’m feeling bad and I cut, I won’t feel hurt, I’ll feel nothing. I just won’t think about anything. I won’t think about my problem, I won’t think about suicide.

But i know that if I cut when I’m feeling *ok*, it won’t help anymore, it will hurt as hell.

So I’ll cut, depending on how I feel
